newsitem.title: ITALY: Mafia planned big prison escape, informer says.
newsitem.headline: Mafia planned big prison escape, informer says.

text.p: A former Mafia member who turned state's evidence has told magistrates the crime group planned to blow up a prison wall in Sicily in 1995 to free dozens of inmates, Italian radio reported on Monday.

The report said Vincenzo Sinacori, who was arrested earlier this year, told magistrates the Mafia had scrubbed the plan after authorities of the Ucciardone prison in Palermo changed security procedures around the outer wall.

The plan to free inmates at the jail, where many Mafia members are held, had been drawn up by Giovanni Brusca, the top Mafia boss who was arrested last May. It was to have been carried out between October and November of last year.
Revelations by Sinacori, who has been charged with several murders, allowed police to issue 23 arrest warrants against Mafiosi as part of an operation in Sicily last week.
